definition: To provide money for something, or a sum of money collected for a specific purpose.
example: The government decided to fund the new research project.

definition: Happening or done sometimes, but not often or regularly.
example: We enjoy an occasional visit to the beach during summer.

definition: To a very great degree; very much.
example: The weather was extremely cold yesterday.

definition: A feeling of being extremely tired, either physically or mentally.
example: The long journey caused him extreme fatigue.

definition: Not enough or not good enough for a particular purpose.
example: The small salary was inadequate to cover her living expenses.

definition: Arranged in good proportions; having all elements in the right amount.
example: A balanced diet includes all necessary nutrients.

definition: To happen or take place.
example: The accident occurred late at night.

definition: A sudden, complete, or marked change in something, or a forceful overthrow of a government.
example: The industrial revolution changed society greatly.

definition: Facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid.
example: Scientists need strong evidence to support their theories.

definition: A moral or legal obligation; a responsibility.
example: It is your duty to help those in need.

definition: An injury to the body, especially one in which the skin or other tissue is cut or broken; or to injure someone with a weapon.
example: The soldier suffered a serious wound in the battle.

definition: A place, person, or thing from which something originates or can be obtained.
example: The river is the main source of water for the city.

definition: The process of building or making something, typically a large structure.
example: The new bridge is still under construction.

definition: To pursue someone or something in order to catch them.
example: The dog likes to chase the ball in the park.

definition: The fact of having committed a specified or implied offense or crime; a feeling of responsibility for wrongdoing.
example: He felt a strong sense of guilt after making the mistake.

definition: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water.
example: The drought caused many crops to fail.

definition: A medicine or treatment for an illness or injury; or a solution for a problem.
example: There is no simple remedy for this complex problem.

definition: In addition; besides. Used to introduce a fresh consideration in an argument.
example: The house is too small; furthermore, it needs a lot of repairs.

definition: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.
example: She faced a dilemma: either miss her flight or cancel her meeting.

definition: An expression of praise and good wishes for an achievement or event.
example: Congratulations on your new job!

definition: The usual food and drink of a person or animal; or a special course of food to improve health or lose weight.
example: Eating a healthy diet is important for well-being.

definition: Used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or exact.
example: The journey will take approximately three hours.

definition: To support or actively encourage something; to help something to happen, develop, or increase.
example: We need to promote healthy eating habits among children.

definition: To have a specified origin; to begin or arise from.
example: The custom is said to originate from ancient traditions.

definition: Of chief importance; principal.
example: The primary goal of the project is to reduce waste.

definition: Worthy of attention; striking.
example: She showed remarkable courage during the difficult time.

definition: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.
example: Beauty is subjective; what one person finds beautiful, another might not.

definition: To give authorization or consent to (someone to do something).
example: The law does not permit smoking in public buildings.

definition: The action of showing something to be right or reasonable.
example: There was no justification for his rude behavior.

definition: The refusal to accept or comply with something; or the ability not to be affected by something.
example: The body's resistance to disease can be improved with a healthy lifestyle.

definition: The action of pausing or delaying before saying or doing something.
example: After a moment of hesitation, she opened the door.

definition: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.
example: The evolution of technology has changed our lives significantly.

definition: A slight pain or an uncomfortable feeling.
example: He felt some discomfort in his knee after the long walk.

definition: To suffer severely or die from lack of food.
example: Many people starve due to famine in some parts of the world.

definition: To remove or take away (something) from a particular place or position; to pull back.
example: She decided to withdraw her complaint.

definition: Having the ability to withstand something; not easily affected by.
example: Some plants are resistant to certain diseases.

definition: The best or most extreme example of its kind; or happening at the end of a process.
example: Achieving peace is the ultimate goal.

definition: Equipment or clothing used for a particular purpose.
example: We packed our camping gear for the trip.

definition: The state or process of rotting or decomposing; to fall into disrepair.
example: The old wooden house showed signs of decay.

definition: Feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness; thankful.
example: I am very grateful for your help.

definition: A series of organized activities working towards a particular goal.
example: The politician ran a strong campaign before the election.

definition: A formal discussion on a particular topic in a public meeting or legislative assembly, with opposing arguments presented.
example: There was a lively debate about the new law.

definition: Having a great deal of money, resources, or assets; rich.
example: He became wealthy after starting a successful business.

definition: In a way that relates to economics or finance; or in a way that uses money, time, or resources carefully.
example: The country is developing economically.

definition: A skilled way of doing something, especially a way of doing a task requiring special knowledge or skill.
example: She used a special technique to paint the intricate details.

definition: Willfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it.
example: It was cruel to leave the animal alone in the cold.

definition: A person or organization using the services of a lawyer, accountant, or other professional or business.
example: The lawyer met with her client to discuss the case.

definition: Not firm or secure; liable to fall or shake.
example: The old table was very unsteady.

definition: To observe a special occasion or day with festivities.
example: We will celebrate her birthday next Saturday.

definition: To treat or regard (someone) with contempt or disrespect; or to cause something to become worse in quality.
example: Pollution can degrade the quality of the environment.

definition: To admit that one has committed a crime or a wrongful or embarrassing act.
example: He confessed to eating the last piece of cake.

definition: Complete trust or confidence in someone or something.
example: She has great faith in her team's ability.

definition: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.
example: Many countries strive to achieve full democracy.

definition: Having an uneven or irregular surface; not smooth or level.
example: The road was rough and full of potholes.

definition: To arrange for compensation in the event of damage to or loss of (property, life, or personal liability) in exchange for regular payments.
example: It's important to insure your car against accidents.

definition: A formal meeting of people with a shared interest, typically one that takes place over several days.
example: She attended a medical conference in London.

definition: A public officer appointed to decide cases in a law court; or to form an opinion or conclusion about.
example: It's not fair to judge people based on their appearance.

definition: A consequence, effect, or outcome of something.
example: The test results will be available next week.
